purpose: Invert only the explicit direct-reference edges already approved and materialized by ConfigData Lookup Stage 2. Stage 3 is a lookup projection, not a new semantic interpreter.

reversePolicy.reverseMeaning: For each approved Stage 2 edge sourceId -> targetId, record targetId <- sourceId with its original relation provenance.
reversePolicy.relationCatalog: Each target file stores relation/sourceType/semanticStatus metadata once and references it by a local relation slot.
reversePolicy.stableOrdering: targetTypeOrder, numeric target ID, Stage 2 relation contract order, numeric source ID

requiredChecks: Stage 2 summary status and relation count match this contract
Stage 2 relation set/order exactly matches the frozen Stage 2 contract
only Stage 2 materialized forward index files are consumed as edge input
every Stage 2 direct edge appears exactly once in the reverse indexes
no reverse entry exists without a Stage 2 direct edge
total reverse reference count equals Stage 2 total edge count
all target files, manifest, and summary are byte-identical after regeneration
no transitive, canonical, name-based, or ID-arithmetic relation is emitted

nextStage.goal: Overlay frozen canonical/project consumers beside raw ConfigData lookup references without recomputing their semantics.
